urban-runoff-methods.alt: Rain falls on a city block. A green roof holds rain in plants and soil and releases it slowly. A downspout sends roof water into a rain garden, a planted low spot where water soaks into the ground. Permeable pavement has gaps that let water pass through into the ground. Ordinary pavement sheds the water sideways to a storm drain. Dashed arrows show water soaking in and recharging groundwater.
